o1.F1a.why: CORRECT: the candidate identifies the Rietveld refinement overlaying observed and calculated patterns with Co3O4 and CoO phase reflections, and explicitly notes the difference curve is low-amplitude/flat, matching the key's description.

o24.F6d.why: CORRECT: the candidate reports the same ranking (Li-Co3O4 ~90% > Na-Co3S4 ~58-60% > Na-Co3O4 ~35-37% at 2 ps) and correctly notes Na-Co3O4 plateaus after ~0.8 ps, matching the key.

a2.F2c.why: PARTIAL: the candidate correctly identifies the 1st cycle discharge capacity as ~850–900 mAh/g, consistent with the key's ~865 mAh/g figure, but it omits the key's comparison to the Li value and the mention that structural probes show only minor reaction, without contradicting either claim.
